_notes: v2.0 accuracy pass: the vision model no longer names people (trained face
recognition is authoritative — vision cannot know what Alex looks like) and
no longer guesses the year (EXIF is authoritative). Sam is a PERSON, not a
pet — he must never appear in the pets dimension. Dimensions with
"vision": false are kept for DB/UI compatibility but are excluded from the
vision prompt and ignored if the model returns them. Values are enforced by

people.label: People
people.prompt: (not asked of the vision model — people tags come from trained face recognition, model_version faces-1.0)

occasion.label: Occasion
occasion.prompt: The occasion. Choose a specific occasion ONLY if there is clear visual evidence (cap and gown, birthday cake, decorations, uniforms, luggage/landmarks). Otherwise choose Everyday.

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.prompt: Emotions clearly visible in faces or body language — at most 3. If expressions are unclear or faces are not visible, use Neutral only.

attire.label: Attire
attire.prompt: What people are wearing. Use Casual unless clothing is clearly distinctive.

location.label: Location
location.prompt: Where this was taken. Prefer a specific setting; use Indoor or Outdoor only when nothing more specific clearly fits; use Unknown if you cannot tell.

activity.label: Activity
activity.prompt: The main activity actually happening in the frame — at most 2. Posing means visible people arranged themselves for the camera; never Posing if no people are visible. None if no activity is identifiable.

time_of_day.label: Time of Day
time_of_day.prompt: Time of day judged from the light. Indoor Artificial for indoor shots under artificial light. Unknown if you cannot tell.

milestone.label: Milestone
milestone.prompt: A life milestone ONLY with unmistakable visual evidence (cap and gown, missing-tooth smile, wedding attire, cake with candles). When in doubt, None.

season_holiday.label: Season / Holiday
season_holiday.prompt: Season or holiday ONLY with visible evidence (tree/lights, costumes, snow, fireworks, decorations). When in doubt, None.

group_size.label: Group Size
group_size.prompt: Count the people actually visible. No People if none. Crowd only for large gatherings where individuals blur together.

quality.label: Quality
quality.prompt: Technical quality only. Keeper = sharp, well-composed, frame-worthy. Good = clear and usable. Blurry = motion blur or out of focus. Poorly Lit = too dark/overexposed. Damaged or Faded = scan artifacts, tears, heavy fading.

pets.label: Pets
pets.prompt: Pet ANIMALS visible in the photo. Rex is the family dog. With Other Pet for any other animal. No Pets if no animal is visible. IMPORTANT: Sam is a family member (a person), NEVER a pet — do not use this field for people.

humor.label: Humor
humor.prompt: Is the photo itself funny? Intentional Silly = subjects deliberately goofing. Default to Not Funny.

sentiment.label: Sentiment
values: Why Do We Still Have This
sentiment.prompt: Sentimental weight as a family memory. Core Memory = an irreplaceable moment between family members — people must be visible; never Core Memory for photos of objects or scenery. Why Do We Still Have This = clearly discardable (random objects, accidental shots).

year.label: Year
year.prompt: (not asked of the vision model — the year comes from EXIF taken_at)
